# CC Switch

CC Switch official website: https://ccswitch.io/

Official source repository: https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch

ccswitch.io is the only official website of CC Switch. Other domains using the CC Switch name are not affiliated with the project.

CC Switch is a free, open source (MIT) desktop app for Windows, macOS, and Linux that manages AI coding tools from one place. It supports 10 tools: Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Gemini CLI, and Grok Build (switch mode, one active provider at a time), plus OpenCode, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Pi, and MiniMax Code (coexist mode, several providers at once).

Core capabilities:

- Provider management with 90+ presets, one-click switching, and custom configurations
- Local Routing that converts between Anthropic, OpenAI, and Gemini API formats (for example, GPT in Claude Code or Claude in Codex), with automatic failover, circuit breakers, and request logs
- MCP servers and Skills added once and synced to the tools you choose; prompts managed per tool (CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / GEMINI.md). Supported features vary by tool
- Usage and cost tracking from session logs, even without Local Routing, plus subscription quota and balance on provider cards and the tray
- Session history browsing and search, projects that switch a whole setup at once (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and Codex), and WebDAV / S3 cloud sync
